title: Cosmological anatomy of interacting dark energy
summary: Interacting dark energy (IDE) models, featuring interactions between dark matter (DM) and dark energy (DE), have received significant renewed interest. However, little attention has been devoted to understanding their genuine cosmological signatures, with comparisons against $Λ$CDM often carried out at fixed cosmological parameters. Considering the widely studied model with energy exchange rate proportional to the DE density, we carry out a three-level sequence of comparisons, starting from the naïve fixed-parameter comparison, then compensating for shifts in $θ_s$ and $z_{\text{eq}}$, and…
